records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the six months ended June 30, 2022, approximately 77% of our revenue was derived from consumable products and activity-based equipment, while the balance was primarily derived from capital products with a small amount from rental and other services.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: At the same time, the supply of oil and natural gas was impacted by ongoing capacity constraints by OPEC+ and North American exploration and production companies.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the first half of 2022, the supply of oil and natural gas was further impacted by political and social responses to the Russia and Ukraine war resulting in further increases in energy prices, especially in Europe.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: As a result of these supply and demand factors, commodity prices increased substantially in 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Segment operating income for the three months ended June 30, 2022 was $5.1 million, a $15.1 million improvement compared to a loss of $10.0 million for the three months ended June 30, 2021.
